resets.asserted_meaning: Asynchronously returns the state to S0.

ports.name: in
ports.role: Four-state serial sequence input used by the transition decoder.

ports.name: out
ports.role: Four-state Mealy output pulse on matching 1101, with partial-match retention for overlap.

declared_unknowns.description: The RTL state register has no declaration-time initialization; the test checks unknown output before asserting asynchronous reset.
A directed X input confirms that procedural if follows the RTL false branch; Z behavior is not separately exercised. State encodings outside S0-S3 are unreachable after reset.
RTL state parameters S0..S3 are represented by their defaults (0..3); non-default parameter overrides are not implemented or tested.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
